nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to predict the expected weights of factors.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we developed a normative model by training a Gaussian process regression (GPR) on the ABIDE II TD subjects to predict the expected weights of factors.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Normative model predicts NMF factor weights derived from gray matter volume maps.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Voxel-based morphometry was used to compute gray matter volume. ... we developed a normative model by training a GPR on the ABIDE II TD cohort (29), using age and gender as covariates to predict weights (Figure 1E).
